runtime_fixes: Native daemon binds Unix sockets or Windows named pipes, serves public JSONL/private worker binary frames, dispatches commands, detaches connections, handles termination signals and drains writes on shutdown.

Worker protocol dispatch includes subscription, unsubscription, peer transport registration, archive/shutdown, idle child passivation and message delivery; public and private event routing preserve nested metadata and compact worker frames.
Daemon runtime creation forwards canonical session config, agent directory and scoped client environment; canonical runtime owns the session lease and real subagent host.

Daemon extension UI implements canonical interface, discovers current attached clients, uses live response resolvers, cleans cancelled/dropped dialogs and rebinds fresh sessions without holding state locks through callbacks.
Recovery journal admission, result recording and acknowledgement propagate durable append failures before changing in-memory state.
RPC launches Rust executable, has native stdin/stdout/signal host, preserves command admission and EOF ordering, and uses camelCase command/observed-session fields.
RPC dialogs register and emit synchronously, then resolve through response, timeout or cancellation; unsupported headless custom component resolves None.
Roster transport can provide fresh independent connections, and ordered updates now continue after initial attachment.
Non-Unix worker startup gate supports piped stdin commit marker with exact validation; native runtime identity uses current executable.
Anthropic OAuth authorization, token exchange and refresh use decoded public client ID, matching TypeScript atob result.
Anthropic manual input and browser callback complete independently; manual completion or rejection cancels callback wait instead of joining both forever.
